title: fix(grid): validate email format in the import preview (objectstack#3566)
body:
Companion UI change for objectstack-ai/objectstack#3566. Server PR: objectstack-ai/objectstack#3572.

## Problem
The ImportWizard's per-cell `validateValue` did **no** format check for `email` columns (it fell through to `default → true`), so an obviously-bad address — e.g. a non-ASCII domain like `x@柴仟.com` — passed client validation *and* the server dry-run, and only failed at real-import time inside better-auth. A jarring "passed validation, then failed" experience.

## Change
- Added **`isPlausibleEmail`** — a single-pass structural + ASCII check that mirrors the server's `isLikelyEmail` — and wired it into `validateValue`'s new `email` case. Bad email cells are now flagged red in the preview step, before submit. No regex backtracking (same ReDoS-safety as the server).

## Tests
- `packages/plugin-grid/src/importEmailValidation.test.ts` — accepts normal, rejects non-ASCII (the reported bug) + structurally-broken, fast on adversarial input.
- plugin-grid import suite (82) green.
